008.evidence: The stables mark lies on the east side of the elongated inlet, west of the coastal road and between two eastern tributaries. 015.evidence: The church symbol lies south of a small coastal brook and north of Rory Chisholm's Brook. The two brooks, coastline and southern inlet constrain the district. 015.next: Find a site plan, dated photograph or parish account explicitly locating the earlier church.
